title: Crisis Reserve for Repeat Psychiatric Admissions under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Repeat admissions keep a crisis reserve when the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime is confirmed under **Referrals and Authorizations**.

## Records read

The inpatient mental health admission lines of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines dated in the last three months and in the last twelve months.

## Rule

1. Where two or more inpatient mental health admission lines of the patient are dated in the last three months, **2 days** are held.
2. Where fewer than two are dated in the last three months but two or more are dated in the last twelve months, **1 day** is held.
3. Otherwise nothing is held.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Admission lines in the last 3 months | Admission lines in the last 12 months | Days held |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 1 | 3 | 1 |
| 0 | 2 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 |
